---
title: "Paul Krugman, Enemy of Progress"
date: "2009-02-17"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

Brink Lindsey debunks Paul Krugman’s [nostalgianomics](http://www.cato.org/pubs/wtpapers/Nostalgianomics.pdf "nostalgianomics"):

> *the caricature of postwar history put forward by Krugman and other purveyors of nostalgianomics won’t lead us anywhere. Reactionary fantasies about the good old days never do.*

Krugman’s caricature is similar to Kevin Rudd’s [attempt](../2009/neo-liberalism_triumphed_in_1978._who_knew.qmd "attempt") to elevate the pre-1978 period to a mythical Golden Age before the ‘triumph of neo-liberalism.’
